scope: Sanitized architecture and operating metadata only; no credentials, personal context, private URLs, or customer data.

systems.title: Codex
systems.source: Global and repository AGENTS.md files, Git-backed personal skills, and installed plugin manifests
systems.measurement: Live CLI version; resolvable direct skill manifests; one current directory per managed plugin; distinct MCP sections; desktop automation definitions and statuses.
systems.trigger: Interactive desktop, CLI, or IDE task; optional desktop scheduled task
systems.permissions: Per-task filesystem, network, app, and approval policy; connectors retain their own authorization
systems.inputs: Prompt, AGENTS.md chain, repository, thread history, memories, selected skills and plugins
systems.outputs: Workspace changes, reviews, artifacts, GitHub commits, deployments, and verification evidence
systems.proof: Targeted checks, full build when required, commit, deploy reference, live checks, and tracking issue comment
systems.recovery: Install Codex, restore Git repositories and AGENTS.md, restore Git-backed skills, then reconnect plugins and MCP services

systems.title: Claude Code
systems.status: active · specialist catalog and plugin surface
systems.source: Active Claude runtime reconciled with the private vault's Claude configuration tree
systems.measurement: Live CLI version; direct agent Markdown excluding the generated index; recursive command Markdown; direct skill manifests excluding vendored dependencies; plugin registry and active settings.
systems.trigger: Interactive CLI or editor session; project instructions and plugins may add behavior
systems.permissions: Claude settings, hooks, project policy, and each connected service's authorization
systems.inputs: Prompt, CLAUDE.md chain, project files, agents, commands, skills, plugins, and session memory
systems.outputs: Workspace changes, analysis, artifacts, and delegated agent results
systems.proof: Repository checks plus the same GitHub/deploy closeout contract used by other coding runtimes
systems.recovery: Restore the private vault and runtime settings, run the guarded setup workflow, then compare runtime and vault inventories before use

systems.title: Hermes
systems.source: Private Hermes home repository for personalization and schedules; public Hermes fork for runtime code
systems.measurement: Live CLI version; direct profile directories; active cron registry job objects partitioned by enabled state; recursive manifests under the active user skill root only.
systems.trigger: Message, gateway request, cron schedule, or local operational event
systems.permissions: Profile toolsets, action class, approval class, connector authorization, and scheduler policy
systems.inputs: Soul, selected profile, memories, skills, message context, repository context, and tool results
systems.outputs: Slack, Telegram, or Discord replies; local artifacts; monitored workflow results
systems.proof: Scheduler output plus independent evidence contracts and the Context fleet scoreboard
systems.recovery: Restore the private Hermes home repository and secrets from 1Password, install the public runtime fork, restore launch services, then run gateway and delivery checks

systems.title: Context control plane
systems.source: Private Context repository manifests, scripts, evidence contracts, and generated fleet scoreboard
systems.measurement: Generated system inventory reconciled with live runtime state and the fleet scoreboard snapshot.
systems.trigger: Hermes cron, GitHub Actions, launch services, or an explicit operator run
systems.permissions: Declared action and approval class per system; external writes require a preapproved playbook or operator approval
systems.inputs: Scheduler definitions, local runtime status, collector outputs, evidence contracts, and repository state
systems.outputs: System inventory, fleet scoreboard, proof artifacts, alerts, and curated context updates
systems.proof: Generated inventory and scoreboard with explicit verified, unverified, failed, idle, and paused states
systems.recovery: Clone the private Context repository, restore referenced credentials, validate scheduled surfaces, then regenerate the inventory and scoreboard
systems.version: repository revision 07b3fc0 baseline plus live working-state inventory

systems.title: Knowledge vault
systems.source: Private vault repository; canonical storage policy lives in its InnerContext area
systems.measurement: Repository status and current canonical storage policy reviewed at the snapshot date; no volatile count published.
systems.trigger: Human curation, approved automation update, or explicit agent workflow
systems.permissions: Private repository access; sensitive areas remain encrypted; secrets are prohibited
systems.inputs: Curated decisions, goals, identity context, workflows, research syntheses, and system guidance
systems.outputs: Versioned knowledge and context consumed selectively by agent runtimes
systems.proof: Git history, link checks, storage-policy compliance, and reviewable automation diffs
systems.recovery: Clone the private repository, unlock approved encrypted content, run its setup checks, and reconnect runtime references

systems.title: Shared Firecrawl MCP broker
systems.source: Local broker launcher and the shared Firecrawl CLI configuration
systems.measurement: Broker status command plus a bounded local endpoint health check.
systems.trigger: A configured agent runtime requests web search, scrape, crawl, or extraction
systems.permissions: Local MCP endpoint; service credentials resolve once per authorized 1Password session
systems.inputs: Public URLs, search queries, and structured extraction requests
systems.outputs: Search results, page content, crawl maps, and extraction artifacts
systems.proof: Broker health check plus a bounded read-only request from the calling runtime
systems.recovery: Restore the launcher, resolve the 1Password reference once, start the broker only if stopped, then test the local health endpoint

systems.title: Gemini CLI
systems.source: Local Gemini configuration plus Git-backed project instructions
systems.measurement: Live CLI version, configured MCP entries, and local skill manifest count.
systems.permissions: Local CLI policy and connector authorization
systems.inputs: Prompt, repository context, Gemini instructions, and configured MCP results
systems.outputs: Analysis and workspace changes when explicitly requested
systems.proof: Repository-specific verification and GitHub closeout contract
systems.recovery: Install the CLI, restore non-secret configuration, authenticate, and validate the shared MCP connection

systems.title: Grok CLI
systems.source: Local Grok configuration and marketplace-managed runtime files
systems.measurement: Live CLI version, configured MCP entries, and direct custom-command inventory.
systems.permissions: Local CLI policy, marketplace configuration, and connector authorization
systems.inputs: Prompt, repository context, commands, and configured MCP results
systems.outputs: Analysis and workspace changes when explicitly requested
systems.proof: Repository-specific verification and GitHub closeout contract
systems.recovery: Install the stable CLI, restore non-secret configuration, authenticate, and validate the shared MCP connection

systems.title: Compatibility assets
systems.status: compatibility-only · no active OpenClaw or OpenCode binary
systems.measurement: Executable lookup for target runtimes plus recursive manifest count in the compatibility root.
systems.trigger: Explicit migration or interoperability work only
systems.permissions: No runtime authority while the corresponding binary is absent
systems.inputs: Existing skill definitions and migration requirements
systems.outputs: Portability analysis or converted skill packages
systems.recovery: Install a target runtime only when deliberately adopted; otherwise retain the assets as inactive references

systems.title: Super Agents documentation portal
systems.source: This GitHub repository; runtime truth remains with each owning system
systems.measurement: Pinned package lock, generated registry checks, production build, access matrix, search index, responsive browser review, and deployment evidence.
systems.trigger: Reviewed documentation change merged to the deploy branch
systems.permissions: Public source content must remain sanitized; rendered site also requires configured access credentials
systems.inputs: Reviewed registry snapshot, authoritative runbooks, official product docs, and bar-raiser findings
systems.outputs: Searchable Nextra site, source map, operating guides, and dated system snapshot
systems.proof: CI checks, dependency audit, production deployment, unauthenticated/authenticated route checks, and issue closeout
systems.recovery: Clone the repository, use the pinned Node version, regenerate the registry page, run checks and build, then redeploy with access variables
